QF.id: AIFM CII Fund Monitoring Reporting and Exit_36

question.text: In the mandatory exit process for dissenting investors following a material PPM change or change of control, the ENTIRE exit process must be completed within what timeframe from the date of expiry of the last date for dissent?

explanation.text: The Logic: Per Chapter 12 (SEBI Circular CIR/IMD/DF/14/2014): 'The entire process of exit to dissenting investors shall be completed within 3 MONTHS from the date of expiry of last date of the offer for dissent.' The dissent window itself is 'not less than one month.' The Trap: 1 month is the dissent window, not the completion window. 6 / 12 months are invented. Cross-Exam Context: XIX-C identical. Distinguish: 1 month (dissent window) → valuation by 2 valuers → 3 months (exit completion). Common multi-step-timeline trap. Manager's Pro-Tip: Engage two independent valuers at DAY ZERO of the dissent window so you have signed valuation reports within 30-45 days. If valuation drags, you risk breaching the 3-month completion deadline — a regulatory violation AND LP-relations disaster.
